description: Lending liquidations per chain, protocol and direction over a window: event count, distinct borrowers and liquidators, and per token the amount liquidated (debt covered and collateral seized) with its USD value where the price is certain (USD stablecoins at $1; ETH, BTC, BNB, AVAX and POL and their wrapped tokens at the latest hourly close; other tokens amount only, counted in unpricedLegs). Compound v2 and Venus: the borrowed token from the market that emitted the event; the seized token on events recorded from 2026-10-13. oracle: per group, the liquidations checked for an oracle price update (Chainlink AnswerUpdated or Pyth PriceFeedUpdate) before them in the same transaction (sameTx), in the transaction right before (prevTx) or earlier in the block (sameBlock); null for events before the check started. window in hours, default 24, max 720; each hour is published about 90 minutes after it ends. Omit chain for all Chains covered: ethereum, bnb, avalanche, polygon. Price: 2 cents per call.

chain.description: One of ethereum, bnb, avalanche, polygon; absent = all four. Example: bnb

window.description: Window in whole hours, 1 to 720, default 24. Example: 72

name: liquidations

dataGaps.description: Present only when the window of the answer overlaps a recorded data gap. Figures inside each listed period are incomplete. periods are the recorded gaps (end null while still open); atCall is measured against the window of this call and is left out of meta.contentHash.
